author: IGN
description:
Check out the trailer for season two of The Terminal List, the action-packed series starring Chris Pratt, Tom Hopper, Constance Wu, Dar Salim, and Luke Hemsworth. All eight episodes of Season 2 of The Terminal List will premiere on Prime Video on October 21, 2026.

From the best-selling novels of the same name, The Terminal List centers on Navy SEAL Commander “James Reece” (Chris Pratt) as he battles unknown conspiratorial forces seeking to upend the world order. This season comes from Jack Carr's second novel, True Believer, where he puts “James Reece” on a journey of violent redemption, finding a new purpose after finishing his list. The psychological revenge thriller of Season One opens up into a globe-trotting espionage thriller taking Reece across the Indian Ocean, Southern and Northern Africa, the Middle East, and Europe. Joined by returning fan favorites like “Raife Hastings” (Tom Hopper), “Katie Buranek” (Constance Wu), “Mohammed Farooq” (Dar Salim), “Jules Landry” (Luke Hemsw
title: The Terminal List: Season 2 - Official Trailer (2026) Chris Pratt, Constance Wu, Luke Hemsworth

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
GameStop and other 3rd-party retailers are hiking the price for used PS5 Pro's to an astronomical $1,400. As of this taping, GameStop is out of brand-new PS5 Pro's, which still retail for the Sony-suggested $899, but demand as skyrocketed since the previous price hikes, and in anticipation of GTA 6, which will may take advantage of the extra power. In related news, ex-PlayStation Boss Shawn Layden thinks Sony killing off discs is a step in the wrong direction, despite agreeing with the majority of customers who buy games digitally.
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.
title: Used PS5 Pro Prices Skyrocket to $1,400 at GameStop, 3rd Party Retailers - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Get a deep dive into the Detective System of Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy in this latest trailer for the upcoming grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy will be available on PC (Epic Games Store, Steam, and GOG), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy - Official Detective System Overview Trailer

author: IGN
description: Warhammer Survivors is shaping up to be another great adventure for fans of both Vampire Survivors and Warhammer, and I’m excited to see how the full game unfolds and adds to the fun I experienced in this short demo. It’s not doing anything groundbreaking, from what I can tell, but it has added meaningful additions that really honor the source material in a unique way that benefits gameplay. All I know is that all I want to do is jump back in for one… more… round… and that’s one of the highest compliments you can give any game. Previewed by Adam Bankhurst
title: Warhammer Survivors Aims to Be a Celebration of Both Warhammer and Vampire Survivors | IGN Preview
